title: interview-calibration-handoff-scratch-sofia
content:
SCRATCHPAD: interview calibration + handoff notes (headcount sync prep)
Owner: Sofia Patel — quick notes for 1:1 + weekly hiring sync
Context:
- Preparing for weekly headcount + interview-loop alignment (hiring sprint 6). Focus: close offers for infra eng (3 ICs), lock interview panel for SRE lead, align rubric for applied-ml senior roles.
- This is messy/wip — collecting points to raise with Arjun & recruiting.

Meeting goals (what I want to get from sync):
1) Confirm hiring runway for infra eng: which reqs get priority if we hit budget cap? (fast-failure list)
2) Calibrate interview rubric for senior applied-ml (score thresholds / must-have signals)
3) Finalize handoff checklist for offer + onboarding ops (recruiter -> hiring manager)
4) Agree on interviewer pool and backup interviewers for SRE lead loop

Agenda (30–45m):
- 5m quick numbers: open reqs, offers outstanding, projected comp spend this month
- 10m interview rubric calibrations (applied-ml senior + infra eng SWE)
- 10m interview loop logistics & backup interviewer plan for SRE lead
- 10m handoff checklist and recruiting Ops tasks + timelines

Data snapshot (to quote in meeting) — pull from hiring sheet before meeting:
- Open reqs relevant: INF-ENG (3 reqs, 2 offers ext, 1 final-round), SRE-LEAD (1 req, 1 onsite scheduled), APML-SR (2 reqs), PM (1 paused)
- Offers outstanding: 2 ext (infra eng) — both verbal acceptances pending comps approval
- Recruiting pipeline: 14 active candidates across priority reqs, time-to-offer median 28d (improve target 21d)

Rubric notes (quick proposed changes) — bring to calibration:
- Applied-ML (senior): score 1–5 per axis: technical depth, system design ML, productionization experience, mentoring/leadership, culture match. Pass threshold: >=4 on technical depth AND >=3 on productionization.
- Infra-eng SWE: emphasize debugging at scale, infra tooling, incident postmortem practices. Require at least one deep postmortem discussion in loop.

Interview loop logistics / backup plan:
- SRE lead panel: (default) Arjun (onsite interviewer), Maya (systems), Priya (culture/behavioral), Hiring manager (Kenji).
- Backup pool: Sam (on-call infra), Diego (platform), Noor (SRE senior) — ask recruiters to hold 2 windows in next 7 days.
- If Arjun unavailable, auto-fallback: Diego -> prioritize local timezone. Need to confirm Diego's availability (Slack).

Debrief workflow (proposal to reduce friction):
1) 30-min debrief window immediately after onsite (all interviewers in private doc).
2) Each interviewer fills short debrief form (1–3 sentences + 1 numeric score). Template snippet below.
3) Hiring manager summarizes top-3 signals and recommends (yes/no/hold) within 24h.
4) Recruiter compiles feedback + sends follow-up to candidate with decision timeline.

Debrief form (short):
- Candidate name / role / date
- Top strengths (2 bullets)
- Top concerns (2 bullets)
- Numeric overall (1–5)
- Hire recommendation: Yes / No / Hold
- Any must-check references? Y/N and who

Handoff checklist (recruiter -> hiring manager -> onboarding) — small, actionable list:
- Recruiter: confirm comp band and verbal offer script approved (deadline: +48h)
- Hiring manager: confirm role expectations doc + first 4 weeks plan (deadline: +72h after accept)
- People-ops: create new-hire intake ticket and pre-onboard checklist (IT access, GSuite, slack channels)
- Recruiter: schedule 1st-day intro with buddy and manager (in calendar)

Open questions / risks to surface:
- Budget: if we need to pause one infra req, which one (Req A vs Req B)? Suspect Req B is lower priority — need to confirm with product lead.
- Interviewer availability is tight next week (conference). Have backup list ready.
- Offer comp approval workflow delays: raise to Arjun for escalation if not done in 48h.

Notes-to-self (for the 1:1 with Arjun):
- Ask for quick skimming of HRPLAN-78 (linked) and whether comp reserve can be shifted for the month.
- Confirm Diego as backup and ask Maya to run a 20m calibration session for the applied-ml rubric (recorded).
- Remind recruiting to block 2 interviewers for SRE lead into next-week buckets.

Follow-up messages to draft (copy to slack):
- Short message to #recruiting: "Heads up — SRE lead onsite scheduled 11/12; need backup interviewers Diego/Noor to hold 11/12 9–12am. Please confirm by EOD 11/06."
- Message to Arjun: "Can we escalate comp approvals for two infra infra offers? I need greenlight within 48h or we'll risk losing candidates."

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Sofia: confirm numbers + paste updated table from hiring sheet into meeting notes (due 2024-11-06)
- Arjun: check comp reserve and reply re: HRPLAN-78 (due 2024-11-07)
- Maya: run 20m rubric calibration for applied-ml and share recording (due 2024-11-08)
- Recruiting (Priya): hold backup interviewers and confirm availability (due 2024-11-06)
- Diego: confirm willingness to be backup for SRE lead (due 2024-11-06)

Quick templates to copy during meeting (to make decisions fast):
- Offer escalation note: "Need comp approval for [Candidate X] for INF-ENG Role; proposed OTE $XXXk. If no approval by [date], withdraw offer."
- Debrief quick line: "Strong technical depth, production experience limited — recommend hold for reference check."

Random thoughts / heuristics (notes to archive later):
- Keep TTR target at <=21d for high-priority reqs — recruiter performance metric.
- For senior applied-ml, prioritize candidates who have shipped: clear metric of impact > academic pedigree.

END — keep as personal scratchpad. Move items to canonical docs (confluence / hiring sheet) after sync.
